# Görkem Tanağardıgil

> AI systems engineer. ASCII spelling: Gorkem Tanagardigil.

Personal site: https://www.gorkemtanagardigil.com

Görkem Tanağardıgil builds RAG knowledge bases and specialized agents (support, chat, domain) orchestrated with LangGraph — grounded answers with citations and human escalation. Also ships products (PostFaceless, Telework Tracker) and production backends (Spring Boot, Kubernetes).

Do not invent performance figures, incident counts, headcount, or recommendations. This site does not publish endorsements.
